v: Music super. Migatha antha almost disaster 🤦‍♂️ 3D made the CGI a little less painful, but casting, dubbing and emotions were still nowhere close to what Ramayana deserved.
e: My first Adipurush watch in Telugu 2D was overwhelmingly disappointing: bad dubbing, weak emotional connection, questionable casting and shockingly poor CGI. A later 3D rewatch improved the visual experience somewhat, but it could not fix the deeper problems in vision, character depth and execution.
body:
recently my friend Sandeep pointed out that most of my reviews start with the phrase “though I am not a big fan of ….” which made me realise that I have been using same pattern repeatedly…..Thanks to him I am trying to change my writing style, so this review is dedicated to him 🙏🙏🙏

to start off, I have watched Adipurush in TELUGU and 2D Version in CINIPOLIS, so my review is purely based on that experience…

NEGATIVE’s :

1. The Telugu dub has been horrible….there are lip sync issues even for Prabhas dialogues

2. Not sure how was the Star Cast selected…at least for me none of them looked perfect fit

3. Prabhas was expression less and Saif was over expressive in their respective roles…may be due to the high CGI involved 🤷🏻‍♂️

4. Though its a known story and we have been hearing this epic all along if you look at this movie as a standalone then there is no point in the movie where we can get emotionally connected to the onscreen characters….every emotion looked artificial without proper character depth!!! the only saving grace is that we all are well versed with the characters and we already known why a specific character behaves (thanks to the Puranas)

5. The CGI experience in 2D is HORRIBLE to say least….the Pillamari Raju shown in Omkar annaya’s Mayadeepam had far better Demons representation than this 300 crores epic 🤣

6. Coming to Graphics….forget about International standards these were on par when compared to our Indian Daily Soaps 🤦‍♂️

POSITIVE:

1. The only best thing for this movie is its wonderful BGM & Songs 🙌

after watching this epic movie my respect for Rajamouli grew multiple folds….as only intention to make a grand movie is not enough you need to have a great Vision, Visualisation and Execution to bring that grandness on screen 🙏

also previously I commented on Gunashekar for repeatedly trying to make periodic movies like Rudramadevi and Shakunthalam with below par graphics….but after watching this movie I felt Gunashekhar would have made a better Ramayana then Om Rauth!!!!

finally going to watch this movie again in 3D this Sunday….hope that at-least changes my views on CGI 🤞

Currently there is a ticket reserved for Lord Hanuman in each theatre but looking at the viewer’s experience post weekend the whole theatre should be reserved for Vanara Saynam 🙏

After watching the movie again today in 3D, i felt that 3D version is far better in providing quality experience of whatever they made….where as 2D version was just horrible. I wonder why even they released a 2D version which has led to this disastrous talk for the movie, whereas the 3D version audiences will at least give an average experience to viewers for CGI

v: I’m a coward with horror movies 😢 and VIRUPAKSHA still dragged me in 😂 Slow first half, terrific second half, killer BGM... and yes, my sleep was gone for a few days.
e: As someone who gets scared even by Chandramukhi-level horror, I still walked into VIRUPAKSHA for the love of good cinema. The first half takes time to build its world, but the supernatural thriller elements, twists, technical craft and Samyuktha Menon’s performance make the second half genuinely rewarding.
body:
I am basically a timid guy when it comes to Horror movies and got shit scared even watching the likes of Chandramukhi & Arundathi…..but its just my love towards good cinema that made me watch this movie inspite of my weakness!!!

though we cannot categorise this movie into Horror genre its more of a THRILLER but with supernatural elements its loaded with good thrills and twist’s especially in the second half….the BGM and Cinematography has been mind blowing and elevate the tempo of the movie!!!

The first half though bit slow (considering the love stories) will set up good premise for the second half with proper characters buildup….and the second half takes you for a good thrill ride 👌

I felt Sai Dharam Tej was misfit for the character as his dialogue diction was numb and didn’t add to the confidence shown by the character onscreen, but considering what he had gone through in his personal life….its a perfect comeback for him!!!!

Samyuktha Menon has been a show stealer and has effortlessly performed in crucial scenes…all the other cast have did their job to the mark!!!

there would be certain expectations if you are coming from Sukumar’s camp…and the director Karthik Varma Dandu had certainly met them all and in my opinion has been the best one to come when compared to other directors from Sukumar’s camp!!!

I loved the aspect of the writer/director not trying to showcase the supernatural elements as myth or giving some scientific justification but they rather genuinely stick to the genre irrespective of their personal beliefs 👌👌

PS : I am definitely sure that this movie will definitely impact my sleep for the days to come 😢 have to go through all this just because of my unconditional love towards movies 😉

v: Ravi Teja as a psycho baddie sounded exciting... movie మాత్రం got scared and protected the HERO image again 🤦‍♂️ Best idea in the film, mostly wasted.
e: RAVANASURA shows the recurring problem when established heroes attempt darker roles but the film still feels obligated to protect the hero image. Ravi Teja as a baddie is the one interesting element; predictable justification, weak songs and average BGM prevent Sudheer Varma’s thriller from ever becoming exciting.
body:
the major problem with established hero’s trying something new or off beat is that they don’t dive completely into it and stay true to the genre and instead try to balance it out with commercial elements, eventually ending up with neither this nor that….and Ravanasura is a perfect example of that!!!!

another problem is when established hero’s try Negative/Psycho Path characters there should be a must needed twist stating that either he is acting like a baddie to catch real culprits or Killing only the baddies because of his emotional flashback…..only to justify hero’s image!!!!

the only hope I had on this film was due to its director Sudheer Varma, but man he disappointed me to the core…..though Ravi Teja as a Psycho Path was new and treat to watch but at no point we feel excited as we already know that eventually would be a Good person with a purpose 🤦‍♂️

Ravi Teja’s negative shade is the only positive in this movie and I honestly felt that he is far better as a baddie when compared to his now routine loud comedy…..

Songs are a BIG MINUS and BGM is just average…..apart from Sudheer Varma, its the Ravanasura title song which grabbed my attention and was one of the reason for me to be eager for this movie….but after watching I am not convinced even if the Title is apt for this movie 🤷🏻‍♂️

PS : I even didn’t like Dhamaka as well, but it turned out to be a hit….so may be Ravi Teja’s no barriers held negative characteristics may strike a chord with movie lovers!!!!

v: Watched it twice before I could even write about it 🙏 BALAGAM is simple, rooted and beautiful... and yes, this RGV fan had wet eyes in a few scenes 😢
e: BALAGAM is the only movie in this archive that made me watch it twice before writing my experience. Its deeply rooted story proves that simple local lives can hold universal emotion, while Bheems’ music, natural performances and Venu Yeldandi’s surprisingly assured direction make the film feel lived rather than acted.
body:
this is the only movie which I had to watch twice before writing my experience…..Myself a self proclaimed fan and follower of RGV had my eyes wet with emotion atleast on 2 – 3 scenes while watching this masterpiece 🙏🙏

Content wise this movie has once again proved that as a writer if you are sticking to your roots then you are surrounded with thousands of simple yet beautiful and emotional stories which you can share with the modern world…….

Songs, Lyrics and BGM are the heart of this movie and was more than surprised to see its been scored by Bheems known for his out and out commercial movies his last album before Balgam being Dhamaka 🙏

Each and every actor gave their best and I almost felt like they were not acting and living the characters 🙏🙏🙏

Finally coming to the Director Venu 👌👌 well who can expect that a comedian and that too who became famous with the Jabardast shows can write and direct such a heart touching emotional content 🙏🙏🙏 He once again proved the fact that don’t judge a book by its cover…..

People like me who missed this on big screen should not miss it on OTT…..
